tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Medium tags (topics), e.g. artificial-intelligence, python, startup, productivity, or medium.com/tag/... URLs.

tagSort.title: Tag feed
tagSort.description: Which feed of each tag to read. Newest with a schedule collects new articles as they are published.

searchQueries.title: Search keywords
searchQueries.description: Medium article search, e.g. vector database, remote work, ozempic.

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: Usernames, @usernames or profile URLs, e.g. karpathy, medium.com/@username, username.medium.com. Returns their articles, newest first.

publications.title: Publications
publications.description: Publication slugs, URLs or custom domains, e.g. data-science-collective, medium.com/better-programming, towardsdatascience.com.

articleUrls.title: Article URLs
articleUrls.description: Individual Medium articles, on medium.com or a publication's own domain.

includeContent.title: Article text
includeContent.description: Adds each article's text with headings, lists and code blocks. Members-only articles give only their opening paragraphs. Costs $0.004 per article instead of $0.002.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max articles per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Stop each tag, search, author or publication after this many articles.
